purpose: Verify shared S09-S11 valuation behavior across business models without creating real-company investment conclusions or ticker-specific logic.

valuation_status_cases.evidence_path: Scenario price sensitivity is reproducible, but the driver forecast and independent cross-check are incomplete.
A validated driver-based forecast and at least one validated independent cross-check are both present.
The explicit horizon, driver forecast, forward share bridge, reverse valuation, multiple independent methods, and human review are validated.

insufficient_for_upgrade: Driver forecast without an independent cross-check.
Independent cross-check without a driver forecast.
Multi-method S11 context without a validated S09 horizon.

required: At least one validated independent valuation cross-check.
Validated S09 valuation horizon and base-case return contract.

return_language_rules: Price sensitivity is not a target price.
Base-Case Return is displayed only when the S09 horizon and exit basis validate.
Probability-Weighted Return is displayed only when S09 and probability governance both validate.
Partner Internal Return, position sizing, portfolio action, and trade execution remain disabled outside Gate 4.
Rounded presentation values are allowed, but authoritative calculations must remain reproducible.
No status label may create a precise return that its underlying evidence does not support.
real_contract_rules: Existing public-company contracts are inspected offline and are not backfilled with synthetic valuation assumptions.
Missing S10 or S11 analyst inputs must remain NOT_PROVIDED, DRIVER_MODEL_NOT_AVAILABLE, RANGE_ONLY, or another explicit safe state.
Synthetic acceptance fixtures must be labeled SYNTHETIC_ACCEPTANCE_ONLY and must never be represented as public-company research.
anti_overfitting_acceptance: No ticker, company name, hard-coded company value, or fixture ID may control analytical status or output language.
All status cases must run through the shared S09, S10, S11, share-bridge, and valuation-scope components.
A failure may only be fixed in shared valuation logic or shared validation logic.
After any shared fix, all controlled business-model cases, all status cases, the complete test suite, and the frozen Friday V1 baseline must be rerun.
